title: Service Charge Rate Taken on Breakfast at a Hotel Departure
content:
A departure service charge is added on the breakfast standing on the folio of a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range. The rate it is taken at is read from the on-site extras standing on that folio.

Where the on-site extras standing on the folio number 5 or more, the service charge rate is 18 percent. Where they number 2 or more but fewer than 5, the service charge rate is 12 percent. Where they number fewer than 2, the service charge rate is nil.

| On-site extras standing on the folio | Service charge rate |
| --- | --- |
| 5 or more | 18 percent |
| 2 to 4 | 12 percent |
| Fewer than 2 | Nil |

The number read here is a count of the on-site extras standing on the folio, not their money total.

*Both sides of each threshold, on hypothetical folios.* A folio carrying 5 on-site extras gives 18 percent; carrying 4 it gives 12 percent; carrying 2 it still gives 12 percent, 2 being the foot of that band; carrying 1 it gives nil.

*Carried through, on hypothetical figures.* Where 84.00 USD of breakfast stands on a folio carrying 6 on-site extras, the rate of 18 percent on that breakfast gives 15.12 USD, rounded to the cent. On a folio carrying 3 on-site extras the rate of 12 percent on the same breakfast gives 10.08 USD.
